	"1:	ldl_l %0,%1\n"
	"	subl %0,%2,%0\n"
	"	stl_c %0,%1\n"
	"	beq %0,2f\n"
	".subsection 2\n"
	"2:	br 1b\n"
	".previous"
	:"=&r" (temp), "=m" (v->counter)

}
